// GOVERNANCE LAYER · SBT PARLIAMENT ON ARBITRUM AetherRing · AetherGovernanceAetherRing · AetherGovernance

Rule the reserve 治理储备 with soulbound rank而权级灵魂绑定

Aether is an SBT-governed on-chain parliament on Arbitrum. Three chambers — Council, Parliament, Elders — weighted voting by 14-rank soulbound identity, and a Safe multisig treasury. Inside that treasury sits the loop's strategic asset: the long-term $SPARK reserve. Influence is earned and bound to your soul; $SPARK buys fuel, never votes. Aether 是部署在 Arbitrum 上的 SBT 治理议会。三院 —— 理事会、议院、元老院 —— 以14 级灵魂绑定身份加权表决，金库由 Safe 多签守护。金库之中躺着回路的战略资产：$SPARK 长期储备。影响力靠挣得、与灵魂绑定；$SPARK 买的是燃料，永远买不到选票。

02 / STRUCTURE THREE CHAMBERS三院结构

Power divided,权力分立， so power behaves权力才有规矩

Legislation, review and veto sit in separate hands. A proposal must survive all three — plus a public timelock — before the treasury moves a single wei. 立法、审查与否决分属三只手。一个提案必须闯过全部三关 —— 外加公开时间锁 —— 金库才会动一个 wei。

Council理事会

EXECUTIVE · LEGALITY & BUDGET执行 · 合法性与预算

Runs the day-to-day and reviews proposals for legality, budget fit and charter alignment before anything reaches a vote.负责日常运营，在一切进入表决前审查提案的合法性、预算适配与宪章一致性。

  • Proposal admission & framing提案受理与定调
  • Emergency pause (never spend)紧急暂停（从不花钱）
  • Elected through AetherElection经 AetherElection 选举产生

Parliament议院

LEGISLATIVE · WEIGHTED VOTE立法 · 加权表决

The citizen body. Votes are weighted by soulbound rank on AetherRing — contribution compounds into voice, capital cannot.公民整体。表决权重由 AetherRing 上的灵魂绑定权级决定 —— 贡献可以累积成声量，资本不行。

  • 14 rank tiers → vote weight14 级权级 → 表决权重
  • Temperature checks off-chain via Havix经 Havix 链下测温
  • Quorum by citizens, not by token supply法定人数按公民数而非代币量

Elders元老院

GUARDIAN · CHARTER VETO守护 · 宪章否决

The constitutional brake. Elders may veto only for charter violations — and every veto must carry written reasons, on-chain.宪法的刹车。元老只能因宪章违规而否决 —— 且每次否决都必须附书面理由，留在链上。

  • Veto power, narrowly scoped否决权，范围狭窄
  • Written, auditable veto reasons可审计的书面否决理由
  • Guardians of the Spark reserve mandateSpark 储备使命的守护人

05 / TREASURY THE SPARK RESERVESPARK 储备

A vault with一座由 fourteen thousand auditors全体公民审计的金库

The Spark reserve is Aether's strategic mandate: fuel banked for the long term, released deliberately. Every movement is a timelocked call that anyone can read — including the AI stewards' liquidity operations, which run strictly inside charter bounds defined here. Spark 储备是 Aether 的战略使命：为长期而储备的燃料，审慎释放。每一笔移动都是任何人可读的时间锁调用 —— 包括 AI 管家的流动性操作，它们严格运行在此处宪章边界之内。

3 / 5
